title: Finite derived direct-image dimension over a separably closed field
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring whose additive group is torsion. Let K be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed], X and Y finite-type schemes over K [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and f : X \to Y a morphism commuting with the structure maps. Then f has finite cohomological dimension for small-etale Lambda-module sheaves, in the sense of [def-kun-cd]: there is an integer d such that H^q(Rf_*(M[0])) is zero for every module sheaf M and integer q>d.

proof.text: A quasi-compact scheme locally of finite type over a field has dimension bounded by a natural number d. Use the proved source-library exists_topologicalKrullDim_le_of_locallyOfFiniteType; this inequality also handles the empty scheme. Compatibility with the structure maps makes f locally of finite type, and the target is locally Noetherian.

The relative torsion-module bound gives vanishing of higher direct images above 2d over the separably closed field. The source homologyRightDerivedLowerStarSingleIsoHigherDirectImage identifies these with H^q(Rf_*(M[0])). An integer q>2d is nonnegative and can be written as a natural degree. Thus 2d is a uniform bound, without a properness or nontrivial-coefficient-ring assumption.
